title: Tensor inheritance of the single-complex base-change condition
statement: For a cartesian square of schemes X' \xrightarrow{g'} X and S' \xrightarrow{g} S, with f:X\to S and f':X'\to S' the vertical morphisms [def-pc-base-change], let K \in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] and let L(g')^*K \to K' be a map in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{X'}). For x'\in X', put x=g'(x'), s'=f'(x') and s=f(x)=g(s'). If for every x' and i\in\mathbf Z the canonical map H^i(K_x\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\mathcal O_{S',s'})\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\mathcal O_{S',s'}}\mathcal O_{X',x'}\to H^i(K'_{x'}) is an isomorphism, then for every E \in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X), the induced map L(g')^*(E \otimes^L K) \to L(g')^*E \otimes^L K' has the same property: its corresponding canonical map at every x' and i is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Accept the pinned canonical comparison tau with its characterization h_tau. Obtain a core monoidal model of derived pullback to establish the monoidal existence clause, using only the model toMonoidal conversion.

Fix E, arbitrary output coordinates c, a point z and an integer i. The tensor stalk coordinate lemma supplies input coordinates d, A-K-flat stalk complexes Q,P, flatness of C over A tensor_R B, the chain map t and the pinned scalar-extension tensor isomorphism gamma. Homology of composites rewrites h_stalk d z j as invertibility of the input module comparison for every j.

Apply localizedTensorComparison_inheritance with the input model, output model and the preceding degreewise hypothesis. It makes the middle comparison invertible in degree i. Rewrite the output stalk comparison using the coordinate equation a;beta;b. Composition with the two coordinate isomorphisms preserves invertibility. Quantifying over c,z,i proves the canonical inherited stalk condition for E.
